data.narrative:
Generalist AI is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company founded by Pete Florence (ex-DeepMind, PaLM-E co-creator), Andy Zeng (ex-DeepMind), and Andrew Barry (ex-Boston Dynamics). The company last posted at $2.0B post-money following $500M+ in total capital raised. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 5 private companies in the same sector and stage vicinity, alongside 1 public comparable.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B to subsequent-stage progression, implies $3.8B. Peer-median analysis across 5 same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables—Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B Series B), Humanoid ($1.4B Series A), Agile Robots ($1.0B Series C), and Nimble Robotics ($1.0B Series C)—yields a median of $1.4B, with a range of $1.0B to $1.8B.

The triangulation across these two methods supports a valuation range of $1.1B (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $2.6B. The wide spread reflects meaningful divergence between peer comparables, which skew below the target's last post-money, and stage-progression mechanics, which support significant upside. Key uncertainties include the early-stage maturity of comparable companies and whether Generalist AI's founding team pedigree and IP portfolio (RT-2, PaLM-E) command a premium relative to the peer median.
